notes: $15.55 standard rate; $16.80 Portland metro; $14.55 non-urban counties (DOL table).
Oregon meal period for work periods over 7 hours falls between the 3rd and 6th hour (DOL table).
Oregon has a statewide predictive-scheduling law for large retail employers — encoded from Oregon BOLI (confidence=high).
No state daily overtime listed in the DOL table.
Drafted from US DOL WHD state tables (confidence=medium) on 2026-11-06; upgrade to primary sources pending.
minimum_wage.effective is the DOL table date (2026-11-05), not the statutory effective date.

Oregon predictability pay: 1 hour for >30 min added, a moved shift without lost hours, or an added shift; 0.5x regular rate per lost scheduled hour for cuts, cancellations or unused on-call shifts (BOLI).

Minors (BOLI): minors must get a 30-minute meal break when working 6+ hours and a paid 15-minute rest break per 4 hours (or major portion) — longer than the adult 10 minutes; not encoded (rest_break has no age scope). Employers need a BOLI certificate to employ minors.

Schedule-change pay (ORS 653.455(2)): 1 h at the regular rate for adding >30 min, changing date/start/end with no loss of hours, or scheduling an additional shift/on-call shift; 1/2 x regular rate per scheduled hour not worked for subtracting hours, moving with loss of hours, cancelling, or an on-call shift not used. Changes of start/end by 30 minutes or less are exempt.

Exceptions (653.455(3)): employee-initiated swaps/coverage between employees; employee written requests; voluntary standby list acceptances (653.432); (k) employer requests extra hours for unanticipated customer needs or unexpected employee absence, employee consents in writing, standby list exhausted first if one exists, and — if the employee is not working at the time — the request is a group communication (to all eligible employees, written or oral); an employee on shift may be asked individually (extensions).

ORS 653.412-.485 do not define 'in writing'; BOLI lists text message as a notice method but the consent standard was not confirmed (OAR 839-026 not fetched), so text_message_counts_as_written=false (conservative).
Coverage (ORS 653.422): retail, hospitality or food-services establishments with 500+ employees worldwide (chains and integrated enterprises aggregated). ORS 653.490 preempts local scheduling laws.
applies_to='both': retail, food services and hospitality (hotels/motels) establishments (ORS 653.412); hospitality not representable in applies_to yet.
excludes_same_day_split=true: ORS 653.442(1): rest period is the first 10 hours after the end of 'the previous calendar day's work shift' or a shift spanning two calendar days.
